description: This pie chart illustrates the "Distribution of data source in the combined training set," displaying a total of thirteen distinct categories. The chart does not utilize a separate legend or internal percentage labels; rather, each slice is identified by an external text label and its corresponding percentage, connected to the segment via a thin callout line. Moving clockwise from the top right, the segments include NQ in dark blue (31.3%), SCIFACT as a very thin greyish slice (0.1%), ENTFA in mustard yellow (1.8%), FACTCC in dark green (2.6%), ANLI in rust orange (4.6%), FEVER in dark teal (16.1%), MULTIFC as a very thin blue slice (0.5%), MULTINLI in maroon (11.3%), PUBHEALTH as a very thin yellowish-green slice (0.5%), SCITAIL in green (1.2%), SNLI in light brown (15.4%), VITAMINC in grey-blue (13.0%), and XSUMHUL in purple-grey (1.6%). The segments are not arranged in any discernible order, such as descending or ascending size, and no individual slices are visually emphasized through explosion, offsetting, or bolding.
